read.thesis: UPS withdrew all forward revenue and profit guidance as US ADV fell 7.3% and Ground Saver costs overran; it is cutting capacity hard (74 buildings, ~9,500 positions, $3.5B cost-out) but the supply-side pivot is not yet showing in margins.

capex.quote: We expect capital expenditures to be approximately $3.5 billion.

triggers.label: All revenue and profit guidance withdrawn
triggers.quote: we are not providing any forward-looking revenue or earnings guidance

triggers.label: US ADV down 7.3%
triggers.quote: our overall U.S. average daily volume declined by 7.3%

triggers.label: Attrition slower than modelled
triggers.quote: our attrition rate was lower than we anticipated, which resulted in higher expense than we planned

guidance.value: withdrawn for Q3 and full year
guidance.quote: we are not providing any forward-looking revenue or earnings guidance
we remain on track to achieve our 2025 expense reduction target of about $3.5 billion
We expect capital expenditures to be approximately $3.5 billion.
we expect to accelerate the pace of Amazon volume decline to approximately 30% year-over-year in each of the third and fourth quarters
We are planning to pay out around $5.5 billion in dividends, subject to Board approval
we expect tax rate to be approximately 23.5% for the full year 2025
